candidates.title: Purge
candidates.visual_feedback: rejected; revision SU05-A02 in review78 awaits approval

scope: Prepared visual fixtures; current catalogue curves, 100 maximum HP and 40 initial HP. Regeneration shows three paid pulses, real-time idle stability and interruption by an 8 HP physical wound. Purge removes two prepared compatible statuses, never heals and does not prevent a new poison status. No recency tie or engine poison/burn damage simulation is decided.
generation: built-in imagegen; genuine alpha and unchanged final PNG sources
status_markers: Reused approved SU04 buff icon, cropped green droplet from SM02 and fire drawing from FE06. Presentation only, no catalogue icon file is modified.
persistent_feedback: Repair filaments animate as long as the prepared channel remains active, including manual wait. Purge is a brief descending cleansing sweep. Common hit reaction and approved blood appear on the physical interruption; no blood on cleansing or poison application.
